title: pilocereus lutescens
intro: Pilocereus lutescens, commonly known as the Golden Pitaya or Yellow Pitaya, is a species of cactus that belongs to the family Cactaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and aid in weight loss. The health benefits of Pilocereus lutescens are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, carotenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
